verdicts.reason: A has no collisions and keeps a clear logo, headline, product, copy order. However, the shoe-in-circle is shrunk into the bottom-left so the product looks minor. 'Full review inside' floats loosely to its right on no shared grid, the NEW VIDEO badge sits off the logo's line, and there is dead space below the headline. B is broken: the white headline runs onto the lime circle, so 'on' and 'ons' become low-contrast white-on-lime. The shoe has come off its circle and is blown up past it, which breaks the original's contained product badge, and the bottom-left caption is cramped against the shoe.
